description.value: The Flamingo Room is a Miami-inspired neighbourhood bar and live music stage tucked beside Havana Vancouver on Commercial Drive, offering an eclectic mix of craft cocktails, late-night Latin-influenced snacks, DJ nights, and live acts. Part of a small family of Vancouver hospitality venues, it also hosts private events, micro weddings, and themed parties, giving it a versatile character beyond a standard bar. A touring cyclist rolling into the Drive after a long day would find a lively, welcoming spot with a full cocktail program and a small but interesting snack menu.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 67m; stands (2 spaces) at 83m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Flamingo Room is an active Miami-inspired bar and live music venue on Commercial Drive, with an events calendar, active menus, and contact details matching OSM. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM lists 1212 Commercial Drive while the website consistently states 1214 Commercial Drive. Menu labels (GA, V, GF, VG) on the snacks page confirm vegetarian, gluten-aware, and vegan options, but no bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 1212 Commercial Drive, but the website consistently shows 1214 Commercial Drive (V5L 3X4 on most pages, V5L 2T4 on /events and /our-events). Website value used; OSM may need correction.
Minor internal inconsistency on website: postal code appears as V5L 3X4 on the homepage/contact page but V5L 2T4 on the events subpages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bar and live music venue on a major cycling corridor (Commercial Drive) in Vancouver; clearly open and publicly accessible.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag live_music=yes is corroborated by the website, which prominently features 'the stage' and lists live music acts and DJ nights.

Packed lunches.detail: Evening-only snack bar concept; no takeout or lunch service mentioned on site

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels on the snacks page include 'V' (vegetarian) on Highlands Style Guac, 'VG' (vegan) on Churro Bombs, 'GA' (gluten-aware) on multiple items, and 'GF' on Grilled Octopus

wow_evidence: Part of a small family of Vancouver hospitality venues
